description: Restore a file to a selected revision (creates a new head revision). Note: workspace files (Docs, Sheets, Slides) are restored via export/import and may lose some formatting.

account.description: Alias of the Google account to target. Optional — defaults to the session/global default account, or the sole authenticated account. Run manage_accounts list to see available aliases.

confirm.description: Safety flag. Must be true to execute restore.

name: restoreRevision
